_doc: Hero classes. hero.json holds the shared rules and the sorceress numbers; a class only lists what differs (base, perLevel, startAttributes, attribute texts). startSkill/basic: first skill and the free fallback attack when no slot fires. melee: the hero closes in on targets instead of keeping distance; reach = tiles a melee skill can hit from. affixText/statText rename shared stats for this class (same ids, same effects). weaponName/weaponBases: weapon drops for this class (same slot, same affixes and implicit). sprite: frame prefix once painted art exists (null = placeholder drawn in code).

sorceress.name: Sorceress
sorceress.blurb: Casts fire, cold and lightning from a distance and keeps her foes at bay.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.blurb: Wades into the pack with a burning, freezing or thundering weapon. More life, built-in damage reduction, fury instead of mana.
